subject.title: feat(hooks): emit session prune lifecycle event

question: What pruning-hook contract should OpenClaw support before this PR lands: bounded metadata-only, raw pruned content behind an explicit trusted opt-in, or no core pruning hook yet?
rationale: The implementation can be repaired mechanically, but maintainers need to choose what session/tool metadata may leave the context-building path and whether hook handlers may ever receive raw pruned content or block pruning.

options.title: Metadata-Only Hook
options.body: Emit `session:prune` from the active pruning path with counts, timestamp, canonical session identity when available, and sanitized bounded tool metadata only.

options.title: Trusted Raw-Content Opt-In
options.body: Allow pruned content only behind an explicit trusted hook or plugin permission with documented privacy, timeout, size, and logging expectations.

options.title: Defer Core Hook
options.body: Keep scheduled indexing as the workaround until a broader memory/prune/reset hook design is approved.

recommendation.title: Metadata-Only Hook
recommendation.body: Emit `session:prune` from the active pruning path with counts, timestamp, canonical session identity when available, and sanitized bounded tool metadata only.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent owns the open implementation candidate and has adjacent current-main hook-surface history.
